thread:
mike_custsuccess: Brindle Financial asking to onboard a multilingual legal/risk model (en/fr/es). They want PRIVATE (VPC) with HSM for keys, PHI redaction pre-filter, do-not-store, and a 90-day eval window. Target p95 latency <250ms for streaming completions. Can we scope cost + infra?

sophie_se: Got it. Do they want fine-tuning or adapters? Model size? Any sample PHI/PII payloads we can run privacy tests on? @raj_ml for safety/evals input.

mike_custsuccess: They trained a 13B (converted) and prefer quantized q4/q8 to save cost. No fine-tune at first, just serving the provided weights. I'll share sample payloads and contact offline.

raj_ml: High-level eval plan: 1) Safety suite (toxicity, hallucination, instruction-following), 2) Privacy leakage tests with canaries, 3) Multilang legal NER accuracy. Need ~200 labelled samples/lang + ~20k unlabeled logs for privacy probes. Perf bench: seq_len 1024, batch sizes 1/4/8. Initial pass ~2 weeks. Will propose a smaller low-latency fallback model for degraded mode.

alyssa_pm: FYI — Brindle's contract renews in ~3 months. Any onboarding delays = renewal risk. Please prioritize an exec-friendly timeline (summary + risks) by EOD Wed. :warning:

nora_eng: For VPC/private we need customer's CIDR + expected QPS and whether they want Dedicated reserved pools or Private on-prem. If Dedicated, we need commit sizing (GPU counts). @mike_custsuccess can you get infra contact?

mike_custsuccess: Emma (vendor contact) is emma@brindle.com — CIDR shared via DM. They said Dedicated reserved GPUs with burst capacity; expect ~20 reqs/s peak, avg 6-8. I'll loop in infra.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-20456 - Brindle Dedicated onboarding (HSM + VPC). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-20456

raj_ml: Quick eval runner snippet to start locally: ```bash
python eval_runner.py --model /path/to/13b_q8 --task legal_ner --langs en,fr,es --canary 'BRINDLE_CANARY_123' --output results.csv
``` I'll push a reproducible notebook + config for batching/seqlen.

sophie_se: Scheduling enablement + security sync for Wed 10am PT. Invite sent to emma + eng-infra + security. Agenda: KMS/HSM integration, retention & do-not-store policy, eval milestones, rollback/canary plan. :calendar:

mike_custsuccess: Adding onboarding plan doc and will DM links here once created. If they want faster SLA we'll try to accelerate infra bench but will flag cost impact.

alyssa_pm: Can someone draft a one-pager on risk & mitigation for leadership? Focus: contract timeline, PHI constraints, fallback model & cost implications. I can own exec comms once it's ready. :thumbsup:

sophie_se: Acknowledged — I'll collate the eval summary + infra notes and drop into the one-pager by Tue COB.

raj_ml: I'll start the safety probes tomorrow and post preliminary numbers in this thread.

mike_custsuccess: Thanks all — will follow up after the security sync and post the customer's sample payloads and CIDR in the ticket.
